rules: 12 teams; auto: ACC/Big12/BigTen/SEC champs + highest-ranked G6 team; 7 at-large; straight seeding, top-4 byes; first round at higher seed; fixed bracket
committee_proxy: Ranked inside each simulation on its own record: 10.34*win_pct + 0.23*power_z + 0.74*sos_z + 1.09*power_conf (h2h-free fit on 2014-2025 committee rankings)
engine: cfbseedR::cfb_simulations() v0.2.0 regular season + committee-proxy selection
basis: Week-0 ensemble and Preseason Power Ratings; every game simulated
conference_method: Conference-only standings and cfbseedR's registered tiebreaker cascades select the finalists; Sun Belt selects one East and one West winner. Championship games are simulated before CFP selection, and their results count toward final committee records. Explicit non-conference games are excluded from conference races. Model Power Ratings proxy unavailable external analytics composites. Future CFP ranking inputs are unavailable; score-based tiebreakers are skipped where simulated per-game points are unavailable. Pac-12 uses the generic cascade; campus title sites use conference seed order.
